title: VIX futures and options February 2028 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the same session as the January 2028 FOMC minutes, and the first settlement this calendar dates from the holiday clause tested rather than assumed
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, and this session read the rule instead of citing it. Cboe's VX contract specification, cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 461,361 bytes, redirect followed): 'The final settlement date for a contract with the "VX" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', and 'If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday.' Applied to the February 2028 contract: third Friday of March 2028 = Friday 2028-03-17, minus 30 days = Wednesday 2028-02-16. NEITHER LEG IS A HOLIDAY — Washington's Birthday 2028 is Monday 2028-02-21 and Good Friday 2028 is 2028-04-14 — so the clause does not fire and the date is the unadjusted Wednesday. THE CLAUSE ITSELF WAS VALIDATED EXHAUSTIVELY, WHICH IS NEW TO THIS CLASS: the same specification paragraph governs weekly VX contracts ('the Wednesday of the week specifically denoted in the ticker symbol'), so the clause can be tested on every settlement Wednesday rather than on twelve monthlies a year. Against Cboe's own final-settlement series, cdn.cboe.com/api/global/us_indices/daily_prices/VRO_History.csv fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 26,597 bytes, 1,268 rows), over the 296 settlement Wednesdays from 2021-01-06 to 2026-09-02 — the era in which that file carries a clean 52-per-year weekly grid — the clause is right 296 of 296. It predicts 13 displacements; the file holds exactly 13 non-Wednesday settlements, all Tuesdays, and the two sets are identical, with the displaced Wednesday absent in all 13 cases. FEBRUARY IS THE STRUCTURALLY SAFEST MONTH, for a reason one step deeper than the proposing lane gave: its Wednesday leg is immune because a February settlement Wednesday can only fall 02-13..02-20 and the sole February closure, Washington's Birthday, is always a Monday — but its Friday leg is NOT immune, because the third Friday of March can be Good Friday, which last happened in 2008 (Good Friday 2008-03-21) and next happens in 2160. February 2028 is clear of both. Corroborated against the OCC/OIC calendar, optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes): with the full clause applied the publisher's 36 monthly-volatility rows reproduce 35 of 36, the sole residual being the already-documented 2027-12-15 dispute, and its three February rows (2025-02-19, 2026-02-18, 2027-02-17) are 3 of 3. That file stops at 2027-12-15 and carries no 2028 row. Filed estimate on three counts: no published primary reaches February 2028; Cboe has not listed the contract (cdn.cboe.com/data/us/futures/market_statistics/historical_data/VX/VX_2028-02-16.csv returns 403, as does every other 2028 date probed, and the live settlement strip still stops at VX/K7 2027-05-18); and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy is satisfied by OCC: only once a published calendar names the date. Promotion requires reading a Cboe or OCC primary that reaches 2028, never recomputing the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL, written 2026-09-09 by this id's own never-assessed initial research after reading the one proposal that existed for it, proposals/vix-expiration-2028-02-16.from-fomc-minutes-2028-02-16.json (#1717 procedure). That proposal's date and its 3-for-3 February record are CONFIRMED; its stated REASON for February's safety is amended — 'February carries no holiday that can move the anchor, because Washington's Birthday is always a Monday' covers only the clause's Wednesday leg, and the Friday leg (the third Friday of March, which can be Good Friday) is rare rather than impossible. The correction does not touch 2028. THE COLLISION THE PROPOSER FLAGGED IS EXACT, NOT APPROXIMATE, and this lane verified it from the settlement side: 2028-02-16 minus 21 days is 2028-01-26, precisely the second day of the FOMC's scheduled January 25-26 2028 meeting, so the D+21 minutes release and the February SOQ land on the same Wednesday by arithmetic rather than by luck. The sequencing is unchanged and worth repeating: trading in the expiring VX contract ends at 8:00 a.m. Chicago time (09:00 ET) and the SOQ prints from the special opening auction, while the minutes drop at 14:00 ET — the settlement is resolved hours before the release, so any story with settlement flow reacting to the minutes has the clock backwards. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty, impact is low, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is settlement-keyed, and the proposer's own matched test on this class is a perfect null. One mechanical detail this lane adds for any later window study: the specification requires the SOQ's time-to-expiration component to 'account for the actual number of days and minutes until expiration', so a DISPLACED settlement computes a 31-day VIX rather than a 30-day one. 2028-02-16 is undisplaced, so its SOQ is a clean 30-day measurement against SPX options expiring 2028-03-17. The 30-day reference window runs 2028-02-16 to 2028-03-17: 22 trading sessions with one closure, Washington's Birthday 2028-02-21. Estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
